description: Shopping Cart agent for the storefront: a read-only view of a shopper's carts. It answers what a cart holds (its lines, destination postal prefix, delivery quote, the shopper's delivery selections, the labelled non-binding cost estimate and whether the cart is ready for checkout) and which carts a shopper has. It exposes exactly what the REST GET endpoints expose, never changes a cart and never places an order.
name: shopping-cart

skills.description: Read one cart by its cartId: lines, destinationPostalPrefix, deliveryQuote, selections, the labelled estimate (minor units, estimateComplete says whether every line is priced) and checkoutReadiness. The same document GET /carts/{cartId} returns, for a cart of any state. Answers a 404 problem when no cart has that id. Persists nothing.
skills.name: Look up one cart

skills.description: Read the carts of one shopper, newest first, optionally of one state (OPEN, CHECKED_OUT, ABANDONED or MERGED). Each entry is the same document get_cart returns. The same answer as GET /carts?shopperId=&state= with every page followed (up to 1000 carts, the newest). A shopper with no carts gets an empty list, not a problem. Persists nothing.
skills.name: List a shopper's carts
